args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing on behalf of Blue Sparrow Tech. We are interested in booking a group stay at City Hub Tokyo for 10 people in June.

Could you please provide information on availability, room types, and pricing for a group of this size? We would also appreciate any details regarding group amenities or special requirements.

Please let me know if you need any additional information from our side.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
